applies_if.value_text: unit is rent-controlled under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance

rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026-2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the most your landlord can raise your rent for the yearly increase from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.requirement_es: Para unidades con control de renta en San Francisco, lo máximo que el propietario puede subir la renta en el aumento anual del 1 de marzo de 2026 al 28 de febrero de 2027 es 1.6%.
rules.quote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
